mentions.claim_text: He recounts prophesying at his old church, before the channel existed, that earthquakes would begin in Oklahoma, and reports the Lord telling him not to be afraid because they would keep getting bigger and increase, naming 5.2 to 5.5 as large for Oklahoma, and running the sequence on to the New Madrid fault.
mentions.quote: I prophesied that there would start to be earthquakes in Oklahoma
mentions.falsify_match: Oklahoma earthquakes increase in magnitude toward 5.2 to 5.5 and beyond.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not, or they decline. Note the original telling is not in this corpus, so its date and wording cannot be checked here.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw the Canadian prime minister as two-faced, publicly presenting himself as an ally of the United States and a friend of Trump while actually serving Macron's agenda and a European coalition, with two different people running two different agendas against America.
mentions.quote: I saw Justin Trudeau being being double Two-Face
mentions.falsify_match: Canada is shown to have worked against the American position while professing alignment with it.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such duplicity surfaces. Note the subject left office in March 2025, which closes the window on this reading of him.

mentions.claim_text: He describes seeing men and women of God in the spirit realm dressed in white suits, white ties, white shirts, white slacks and white shoes, saturated in something like honey with a light shining about three feet out from them.
mentions.quote: the men had white suits on in the in the spirit realm with white ties
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable as given: an image in the spirit realm with no place, date or worldly referent.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail. Recorded because he later applies it as literal protection against bird flu and swine flu, which is a claim about the world.

mentions.claim_text: He says that at the catching away every child aged fifteen and below disappears, taken under the age of accountability, with families searching for them after church, and uses it to call hearers to repent before it is too late.
mentions.quote: it was 15 and below. And so they all disappeared
mentions.falsify_match: Children aged fifteen and under disappear worldwide at a catching away.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such event. Undated, so it cannot expire, but the age cut-off is a specific and checkable detail if it ever occurs.

mentions.claim_text: He reports being warned by the Holy Ghost in visions and dreams that the French president will rise in the days ahead like a Hitler and is an Ishmael to the Isaac, and that the Antichrist himself is being groomed behind a curtain by four devils who comb his hair and groom his face.
mentions.quote: Macron will rise up in the days ahead like a Hitler
mentions.falsify_match: The French president takes dictatorial power or a comparable role.
mentions.falsify_miss: He does not. No date is attached, so the claim cannot expire.

mentions.claim_text: He describes theatre drapes parted only in the middle, and says that when the economy shakes and there is uprising and rioting in the Chinese community and moves against the government, a limited window opens for the gospel to be preached across all of China, and later the same for North Korea, adding that the opening is not large and does not last long.
mentions.quote: I will give you an opportunity for the gospel to be preached in all of China
mentions.falsify_match: A period of open gospel preaching across China during economic and civil disruption.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such opening. Undated, and the size of the window is left deliberately small, which limits what would count.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw an African-American woman in a purple do-rag and a white shirt, which his son then matched to photographs of Harriet Tubman from the Underground Railroad period, and ties it to Black Wall Street and to the repeated Wall Street and New York City impressions of the night before, reading them as a type rather than as a word about New York.
mentions.quote: purple do-rags just like I saw with the white shirt
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable as given: an image matched to a historical photograph after the fact, with no event attached.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail. Recorded because it is the passage that converts the repeated Wall Street impressions into a type rather than a place.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a red railroad car, not an engine, carrying Santa Fe markings and something shaped like a cross with white lettering, with a bomb inside it, and gives that as the reason he had been seeing the words Santa Fe.
mentions.quote: there was a bomb in the railroad car. That's what I saw
mentions.falsify_match: A bomb on a railroad car connected to Santa Fe, or to a Santa Fe-marked rail line.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such incident. Undated, so it cannot expire, but the marking and the vehicle type are specific enough to check if it happens.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a long Chinese-style serpent in shades of purple and lavender with a dark purple fin, dark purple around white eyes with bright green centres, a white mouth, a red tongue and dark purple claws and tail, rising out of the ocean with part of its tail still in the water, and remarks that he has never seen a purple dragon because they are usually red.
mentions.quote: It was a long serpent coming up out of the ocean
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable as given: he offers no interpretation, no place and no date.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail. Recorded because he later reads the colour and the sea as pointing at China.

mentions.claim_text: He says a boogeyman is coming because they do not go to war without one, that there will be attacks against churches in the days ahead, and that he saw a major minister taken out during his own service, which he reports the Lord calling the shock heard around the world, done to bring fear about the revival that is coming.
mentions.quote: I saw a major minister be taken out in his service
mentions.falsify_match: A well-known minister killed during a service.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack. Undated, so it cannot expire, but the setting and the prominence of the target are specific.

mentions.claim_text: He reports a word given while driving, which he dates to February 2025, that certain cryptocurrencies would in future be created for housing loans and car loans, and points to an article discussing exactly that.
mentions.quote: certain cryptos in the in the future would be created for housing loans
mentions.falsify_match: Cryptocurrency-based products for mortgages and car loans reach the market.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not. Undated. Note that crypto-collateralised lending already existed when the word was given, which lowers the bar considerably.
